page.content:
Commercial rights holder that sells the season as a television product.

How Formula One Group connects

  • Character: Bernie Ecclestone — Bernie Ecclestone built the commercial machine the Formula One Group inherited.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — The Formula One Group sells the championship as a global television product.

What is Formula One Group?

The Formula One Group holds the commercial rights to the championship — the paddock, the media, and the calendar Bernie Ecclestone built and Liberty Media later restyled.

Key threads lead to Bernie Ecclestone and Formula 1.
